purpose: Register a no-retraining robustness replication of v88 that supports IIRC articles with fewer than four usable source candidates.

adapter_change_plan.candidate_construction_for_one_to_three_: Keep every usable source; do not fail, drop, replace, or add synthetic evidence.
adapter_change_plan.candidate_router_for_one_to_three_source: Select all available sources without invoking a four-source feature model.
adapter_change_plan.control_cardinality: Cap each requested prefix length to the number of available unique sources and report actual selected cardinality.

primary_comparison.reason: Frozen v88 primary control retained unchanged for a direct robustness replication.

freeze_rule: Freeze the low-candidate adapter, exact v88 model, controls, metrics, gates, partitions, and implementation hashes before preparing any v89 target case.
mutation_rule: Any post-freeze change requires v90 and new untouched IDs.
